hero.subtitle: Since 2012, the leading legal advisory for the French-speaking and international community in Thailand.

history.title: Expertise built over more than a decade

paragraphs.p1: Founded in 2012 in Bangkok, MILA International Legal Advice was created on the conviction that a French-speaking, international law firm could deliver unique value to entrepreneurs, investors and families operating in Thailand.
paragraphs.p2: Over the years, our team has supported hundreds of clients on their most demanding projects — company incorporations, real-estate acquisitions, cross-border disputes, wealth structuring — combining the rigour of European civil law with deep, local knowledge of Thai law.
paragraphs.p3: Today, MILA is recognised as both an academic and practical reference on Thai law, with publications at Springer, Brill and Cengage, and privileged ties with Mahidol University.

team.leadBio: Founding partner, doctor of law and author of leading works on Thai law published with Springer, Brill and Cengage. Over twenty years of experience in Southeast Asia.

stasi.name: Pr. Alessandro Stasi
stasi.shortBio: Doctor of law, leading author on Thai law.
stasi.bio: Founding partner of MILA, Pr. Alessandro Stasi teaches private law and business law at Mahidol University. The author of several reference works on Thai law published with Springer, Brill and Cengage, he has advised private and institutional clients on their most sensitive transactions in Southeast Asia for more than twenty years.

wichai.name: Wichai Jakkrod
wichai.shortBio: Steers cross-cutting matters and client coordination.
wichai.bio: As Project Manager, Wichai Jakkrod oversees the operational delivery of complex matters and coordinates with local authorities. His combined background in law and management lets him orchestrate cross-border work efficiently between the Bangkok and Hua Hin offices.

atitaya.name: Atitaya Srisawet
atitaya.bio: Project Manager focused on real-estate and corporate matters, Atitaya Srisawet coordinates due diligence, contract drafting and exchanges with notaries and Thai administrative bodies. Recognised for her rigour and responsiveness.

amrita.name: Amrita Luthra
amrita.bio: Legal Assistant at MILA, Amrita Luthra supports the team on legal research, English-language memoranda and regulatory monitoring. With a degree in international law, she brings particular expertise in comparative law issues.

pasakorn.name: Pasakorn Nuntutchote
pasakorn.bio: As Project Officer, Pasakorn Nuntutchote handles the administrative coordination of immigration files, company incorporations and licensing. His experience with Thai authorities is a key asset for keeping procedures on track.

nai.name: Nai Khunsriuchen
nai.bio: Legal Assistant attached to the litigation team, Nai Khunsriuchen handles the follow-up of court proceedings before Thai jurisdictions, the preparation of case files and the drafting of pleadings in Thai and English.

publications.title: Our reference publications
publications.intro: Three works published with the leading international legal publishers, today widely regarded as references on Thai law.

thaiPrivateLaw.title: Thai Private Law
thaiPrivateLaw.description: A comprehensive, systematic analysis of Thai private law for international practitioners. The book covers contracts, torts, property and family law, putting Thai solutions side by side with European civil-law approaches.

thaiCivilLaw.title: Elements of Thai Civil Law
thaiCivilLaw.description: A reference textbook on the foundations of Thai civil law. Designed as a teaching tool for foreign-trained lawyers, it sets out the architecture of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code and the structuring principles of local private law.

thaiBusinessLaw.title: A Primer of Thai Business Law
thaiBusinessLaw.description: A practical guide to Thai business law for international companies and investors. Company formation, governance, contracts, taxation, employment law: an operational overview to secure transactions in Thailand.

purposes.text: Data collected via the contact form is used exclusively to respond to your request, schedule a meeting and manage the client relationship.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.text: Processing is based on your consent (Article 6.1.a GDPR) as well as on the performance of pre-contractual measures taken at your request (Article 6.1.b).

retention.title: Retention period
retention.text: Data is retained for as long as necessary to process your request, then archived during the legal limitation period (five years for contractual matters).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, port, restrict and object to the processing of your personal data. You can exercise these rights by writing to info@mila-law.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr) or your national supervisory authority.

paragraphs.p1: This site does not use any advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
paragraphs.p2: Audience statistics are measured via Plausible Analytics, a privacy-friendly solution that does not set cookies and does not perform any cross-site tracking.
paragraphs.p3: Only cookies strictly necessary for the technical operation of the site (such as managing your preferred language) may be placed. These cookies do not require your prior consent under the ePrivacy directive.

paragraphs.p1: This site is governed by Thai law. However, in line with the firm's professional commitments, French citizens may invoke the provisions of French law applicable to the client relationship (in particular regarding data protection and consumer law).
paragraphs.p2: In the event of a dispute and failing an amicable resolution, the competent courts will be, depending on the nature of the relationship, those of the firm's headquarters in Bangkok or those of the client's domicile within the European Union.
